context.blocks:
- for each {name: variable} in {list: list}: Runs the blocks inside once for every item of a list, in order. The variable holds a copy of the item, so changing the variable doesn't change the list.
- if {condition: boolean}: Executes the blocks inside only once, and only if the provided boolean expression evaluates to true.
- {a: variant} {op: string} {b: variant}: Compares two values using operators like ==, !=, >, <. Returns a Boolean.
- append {value: variant} to {list: list}: Adds a value to the end of a list, which makes it one item longer. Tuples can't grow, and sets use add.
- length of {list: list}: Gives how many items a list, tuple or set holds.
- set index {index: int} of {list: list} to {value: variant}: Changes the value at an index in a list. The index has to exist already; append adds a new value.
- index {index: int} of {list: list}: Gives the value at an index in a list. Indexes start at 0, and -1 is the last value.
- scores: The list named scores, shown on its board in the room. Drop it into any block that needs a list.
- passed: The list named passed, shown on its board in the room. Drop it into any block that needs a list.
